newsitem.title: USA: Damark to focus on home fashions, office items.
newsitem.headline: Damark to focus on home fashions, office items.

text.p: Damark International Inc said it will focus on selling more home fashions and small office/home office items in 1997 as part of its goal to expand its share of a customer's purchases.

"We are confident that we can do this without significantly increasing advertising or inventory exposure," Mark Cohn, chief executive of the direct market seller, said in the Minneapolis-based company's annual report.

The company also said that in the near-term it is looking to expand credit as a marketing tool by aggressively marketing private label and co-branded Visa credit cards. Cohn said the company plans to do this without bearing significant credit risk.
The company also said it intends to add additional club concepts, gain access to third party lists for new member acquisitions and build a stronger Internet presence.

"We are moving ahead with our electronic commerce activities but have modest exectations for this media in the coming year," Cohn said. "We will, however, continue to make prudent investments to allow for capture of long-term opportunities.'
Damark shares were down 1/4 at 9-3/4 Monday.
